basic.name: Light of Elune
basic.description:
Heal an ally Hero for 270~~0.04~~. Light of Elune's cooldown is reduced by 1.5 seconds every time Tyrande hits an enemy with a Basic Attack or damages an enemy Hero.

Stores up to 2 charges. Cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

basic.name: Sentinel
basic.description: Send an Owl across the battleground revealing its path, dealing 120~~0.04~~ damage to the first Hero hit, and revealing them for 5 seconds. If a Hero revealed by Sentinel dies, refresh its cooldown.

basic.name: Lunar Flare
basic.description:
After 0.75 seconds, deal 150~~0.04~~ damage and Stun enemies in the target area for 0.75 seconds. Restores 25 Mana per enemy hit.

Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 3%, up to 120%. Double this bonus if the Hero dies within 3 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 10 Heroes, increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Sentinel now pierces the first Hero hit.

Mythic Reward: After hitting 40 Heroes, Every 8th Basic Attacks fires a Lunar Flare, prioritizing Heroes. Attack Range increased by 1.

heroic.name: Shadowstalk
heroic.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380~~0.04~~ Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

heroic.name: Starfall
heroic.description: Deal 92~~0.04~~ damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

trait.name: Hunter's Mark
trait.description:
Reveal a non-Structure enemy and reduce their Armor by 15 for 4 seconds.

Passive: Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal her for 1% of her maximum Health, doubled against targets with Hunter's Mark.

activable.name: Trueshot Aura
activable.description: Activate to grant Tyrande and nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark.

activable.name: Elune's Chosen
activable.description: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level1.name: Ranger
level1.description: Sentinel width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

level4.name: Everlasting Light
level4.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

level4.name: Mark of Mending
level4.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

level4.name: Elune's Chosen
level4.description: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

level7.name: Elune's Gift
level7.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Lunar Flare grants 20% Spell Power for 10 seconds.

level7.name: Kaldorei Resistance
level7.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

level7.name: Huntress' Fury
level7.description:
Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.

Passive: Increase Hunter's Mark duration by 1 second, and its cast range by 25%.

level16.name: Empower

level16.name: Darnassian Archery
